--- app/src/main/java/app/yomikai/shell/library/TitleDetailActivity.kt	
+++ app/src/main/java/app/yomikai/shell/library/TitleDetailActivity.kt	
@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+package app.yomikai.shell.library
+
+import android.content.Intent
+import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
+import android.os.Bundle
+import android.view.LayoutInflater
+import android.view.View
+import android.view.ViewGroup
+import android.widget.Button
+import android.widget.ImageView
+import android.widget.TextView
+import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
+import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
+import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
+import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
+import app.yomikai.shell.R
+import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
+import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
+import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
+
+/**
+ * Экран тайтла: обложка, имя и список глав.
+ *
+ * В главу попадает ровно один том — архив `zip`/`cbz` или отдельная картинка,
+ * вложенная подпапка считается томом автоматически. Это уберігает от ошибки,
+ * при которой «тапаешь по папке — а там одно зерно между вложенными
+ * структурами», и отражает, как программа хранится на диске: тайтл = папка,
+ * главы = содержимое.
+ */
+class TitleDetailActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
+
+    private lateinit var repository: TitleRepository
+    private lateinit var list: RecyclerView
+    private lateinit var titleText: TextView
+    private lateinit var cover: ImageView
+
+    private var title: Library.Title? = null
+
+    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
+        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
+        setContentView(R.layout.activity_title_detail)
+
+        repository = TitleRepository(this)
+        val folderUri = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_FOLDER) ?: run { finish(); return }
+        val folderName = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_NAME) ?: ""
+
+        cover = findViewById(R.id.cover)
+        titleText = findViewById(R.id.title)
+        list = findViewById(R.id.chapters)
+        list.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
+
+        findViewById<Button>(R.id.readAll).setOnClickListener {
+            val t = title ?: return@setOnClickListener
+            startActivity(
+                Intent(this, ReaderActivity::class.java).putExtra(ReaderActivity.EXTRA_TITLE, t),
+            )
+        }
+
+        titleText.text = folderName
+        lifecycleScope.launch {
+            val t = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { repository.title(folderUri, folderName) }
+            title = t
+            // Обложка — первая страница тайтла; без неё экран глав выглядел бы
+            // списком голых имён папок.
+            val coverBytes = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { repository.coverOf(folderUri) }
+            if (coverBytes != null) {
+                cover.setImageBitmap(BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(coverBytes, 0, coverBytes.size))
+            }
+            list.adapter = ChapterAdapter(t.volumes) { volume ->
+                val single = Library.Title(
+                    name = volume.name,
+                    uri = volume.uri,
+                    volumes = listOf(volume),
+                    pages = repository.pagesOf(volume),
+                )
+                startActivity(
+                    Intent(this@TitleDetailActivity, ReaderActivity::class.java)
+                        .putExtra(ReaderActivity.EXTRA_TITLE, single),
+                )
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private class ChapterAdapter(
+        private val volumes: List<Library.Volume>,
+        private val onClick: (Library.Volume) -> Unit,
+    ) : RecyclerView.Adapter<ChapterAdapter.Holder>() {
+
+        override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int) = Holder(
+            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context).inflate(R.layout.item_chapter, parent, false),
+        )
+
+        override fun getItemCount() = volumes.size
+
+        override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: Holder, position: Int) = holder.bind(volumes[position])

2: 
3: import org.jsoup.Jsoup

5: import org.jsoup.parser.Parser
6: import java.io.Closeable
7: import java.io.File
8: import java.io.InputStream
9: 
10: /**
11:  * Wrapper over ArchiveReader to load files in epub format.
12:  */
13: class EpubReader(private val reader: ArchiveReader) : Closeable by reader {
14: 
15:     /**
16:      * Path separator used by this epub.
17:      */
18:     private val pathSeparator = getPathSeparator()
19: 
20:     /**
21:      * Returns an input stream for reading the contents of the specified zip file entry.
22:      */
23:     fun getInputStream(entryName: String): InputStream? {
24:         return reader.getInputStream(entryName)
25:     }
26: 
27:     /**
28:      * Returns the path of all the images found in the epub file.
29:      */
30:     fun getImagesFromPages(): List<String> {
31:         val ref = getPackageHref()
32:         val doc = getPackageDocument(ref)
33:         val pages = getPagesFromDocument(doc)
34:         return getImagesFromPages(pages, ref)
35:     }
36: 
37:     /**
38:      * Returns the path to the package document.
39:      */
40:     fun getPackageHref(): String {
41:         val meta = getInputStream(resolveZipPath("META-INF", "container.xml"))
42:         if (meta != null) {
43:             val metaDoc = meta.use { Jsoup.parse(it, null, "", Parser.xmlParser()) }
44:             val path = metaDoc.getElementsByTag("rootfile").first()?.attr("full-path")
45:             if (path != null) {
46:                 return path
47:             }
48:         }
49:         return resolveZipPath("OEBPS", "content.opf")
50:     }
51: 
52:     /**
53:      * Returns the package document where all the files are listed.
54:      */
55:     fun getPackageDocument(ref: String): Document {
56:         return getInputStream(ref)!!.use { Jsoup.parse(it, null, "", Parser.xmlParser()) }
57:     }
58: 
59:     /**
60:      * Returns all the pages from the epub.
61:      */
62:     private fun getPagesFromDocument(document: Document): List<String> {
63:         val pages = document.select("manifest > item")
64:             .filter { node -> "application/xhtml+xml" == node.attr("media-type") }
65:             .associateBy { it.attr("id") }
66: 
67:         val spine = document.select("spine > itemref").map { it.attr("idref") }
68:         return spine.mapNotNull { pages[it] }.map { it.attr("href") }
69:     }
70: 
71:     /**
72:      * Returns all the images contained in every page from the epub.
73:      */
74:     private fun getImagesFromPages(pages: List<String>, packageHref: String): List<String> {
75:         val result = mutableListOf<String>()
76:         val basePath = getParentDirectory(packageHref)
77:         pages.forEach { page ->
78:             val entryPath = resolveZipPath(basePath, page)
79:             val document = getInputStream(entryPath)!!.use { Jsoup.parse(it, null, "") }
80:             val imageBasePath = getParentDirectory(entryPath)
81: 
82:             document.allElements.forEach {
83:                 when (it.tagName()) {
84:                     "img" -> result.add(resolveZipPath(imageBasePath, it.attr("src")))
85:                     "image" -> result.add(resolveZipPath(imageBasePath, it.attr("xlink:href")))
86:                 }
87:             }
88:         }
89: 
90:         return result
91:     }
92: 
93:     /**
94:      * Returns the path separator used by the epub file.
95:      */
96:     private fun getPathSeparator(): String {
97:         val meta = getInputStream("META-INF\\container.xml")
98:         return if (meta != null) {
99:             meta.close()
100:             "\\"
101:         } else {
102:             "/"
103:         }
104:     }
105: 
106:     /**
107:      * Resolves a zip path from base and relative components and a path separator.
108:      */
109:     private fun resolveZipPath(basePath: String, relativePath: String): String {
110:         if (relativePath.startsWith(pathSeparator)) {
111:             // Path is absolute, so return as-is.
112:             return relativePath
113:         }
114: 
115:         var fixedBasePath = basePath.replace(pathSeparator, File.separator)
116:         if (!fixedBasePath.startsWith(File.separator)) {
117:             fixedBasePath = "${File.separator}$fixedBasePath"
118:         }
119: 
120:         val fixedRelativePath = relativePath.replace(pathSeparator, File.separator)
121:         val resolvedPath = File(fixedBasePath, fixedRelativePath).canonicalPath
122:         return resolvedPath.replace(File.separator, pathSeparator).substring(1)
123:     }
124: 
125:     /**
126:      * Gets the parent directory of a path.
127:      */
128:     private fun getParentDirectory(path: String): String {
129:         val separatorIndex = path.lastIndexOf(pathSeparator)
130:         return if (separatorIndex >= 0) {
131:             path.substring(0, separatorIndex)
132:         } else {
133:             ""
134:         }
135:     }
136: }

package tachiyomi.domain.manga.model

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import androidx.compose.runtime.Immutable
import eu.kanade.tachiyomi.source.model.SManga
import eu.kanade.tachiyomi.source.model.UpdateStrategy
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import mihon.core.common.extensions.EMPTY
import tachiyomi.core.common.preference.TriState
import java.io.ObjectStreamException
import java.time.Instant
import java.io.Serializable as JavaSerializable

@SuppressLint("UnsafeOptInUsageError")
@Serializable
@Immutable
data class Manga(
    val id: Long,
    val source: Long,
    val favorite: Boolean,
    val lastUpdate: Long,
    val nextUpdate: Long,
    val fetchInterval: Int,
    val dateAdded: Long,
    val viewerFlags: Long,
    val chapterFlags: Long,
    val coverLastModified: Long,
    val url: String,
    val title: String,
    val artist: String?,
    val author: String?,
    val description: String?,
    val genre: List<String>?,
    val status: Long,
    val thumbnailUrl: String?,
    val updateStrategy: UpdateStrategy,
    val initialized: Boolean,
    val lastModifiedAt: Long,
    val favoriteModifiedAt: Long?,
    val version: Long,
    val notes: String,
    val memo: JsonObject,
) : JavaSerializable {

    val expectedNextUpdate: Instant?
        get() = nextUpdate
            .takeIf { status != SManga.COMPLETED.toLong() }
            ?.let { Instant.ofEpochMilli(it) }

    val sorting: Long
        get() = chapterFlags and CHAPTER_SORTING_MASK

    val displayMode: Long
        get() = chapterFlags and CHAPTER_DISPLAY_MASK

    val unreadFilterRaw: Long
        get() = chapterFlags and CHAPTER_UNREAD_MASK

    val downloadedFilterRaw: Long
        get() = chapterFlags and CHAPTER_DOWNLOADED_MASK

    val bookmarkedFilterRaw: Long
        get() = chapterFlags and CHAPTER_BOOKMARKED_MASK

    val unreadFilter: TriState
        get() = when (unreadFilterRaw) {
            CHAPTER_SHOW_UNREAD -> TriState.ENABLED_IS
            CHAPTER_SHOW_READ -> TriState.ENABLED_NOT
            else -> TriState.DISABLED
        }

    val bookmarkedFilter: TriState
        get() = when (bookmarkedFilterRaw) {
            CHAPTER_SHOW_BOOKMARKED -> TriState.ENABLED_IS
            CHAPTER_SHOW_NOT_BOOKMARKED -> TriState.ENABLED_NOT
            else -> TriState.DISABLED
        }

    fun sortDescending(): Boolean {
        return chapterFlags and CHAPTER_SORT_DIR_MASK == CHAPTER_SORT_DESC
    }

    companion object {
        // Generic filter that does not filter anything
        const val SHOW_ALL = 0x00000000L

        const val CHAPTER_SORT_DESC = 0x00000000L
        const val CHAPTER_SORT_ASC = 0x00000001L
        const val CHAPTER_SORT_DIR_MASK = 0x00000001L

        const val CHAPTER_SHOW_UNREAD = 0x00000002L
        const val CHAPTER_SHOW_READ = 0x00000004L
        const val CHAPTER_UNREAD_MASK = 0x00000006L

        const val CHAPTER_SHOW_DOWNLOADED = 0x00000008L
        const val CHAPTER_SHOW_NOT_DOWNLOADED = 0x00000010L
        const val CHAPTER_DOWNLOADED_MASK = 0x00000018L

        const val CHAPTER_SHOW_BOOKMARKED = 0x00000020L
        const val CHAPTER_SHOW_NOT_BOOKMARKED = 0x00000040L
        const val CHAPTER_BOOKMARKED_MASK = 0x00000060L

        const val CHAPTER_SORTING_SOURCE = 0x00000000L
        const val CHAPTER_SORTING_NUMBER = 0x00000100L
        const val CHAPTER_SORTING_UPLOAD_DATE = 0x00000200L
        const val CHAPTER_SORTING_ALPHABET = 0x00000300L
        const val CHAPTER_SORTING_MASK = 0x00000300L

        const val CHAPTER_DISPLAY_NAME = 0x00000000L
        const val CHAPTER_DISPLAY_NUMBER = 0x00100000L
        const val CHAPTER_DISPLAY_MASK = 0x00100000L

        fun create() = Manga(
            id = -1L,
            url = "",
            title = "",
            source = -1L,
            favorite = false,
            lastUpdate = 0L,
            nextUpdate = 0L,
            fetchInterval = 0,
            dateAdded = 0L,
            viewerFlags = 0L,
            chapterFlags = 0L,
            coverLastModified = 0L,
            artist = null,
            author = null,
            description = null,
            genre = null,
            status = 0L,
            thumbnailUrl = null,
            updateStrategy = UpdateStrategy.ALWAYS_UPDATE,
            initialized = false,
            lastModifiedAt = 0L,
            favoriteModifiedAt = null,
            version = 0L,
            notes = "",
            memo = JsonObject.EMPTY,
        )
    }

    @Throws(ObjectStreamException::class)
    private fun writeReplace(): Any {
        return JavaToKotlinXSerializable(Json.encodeToString<Manga>(this))
    }

    class JavaToKotlinXSerializable(private val data: String) : JavaSerializable {

        @Throws(ObjectStreamException::class)
        private fun readResolve(): Any {
            return Json.decodeFromString<Manga>(data)
        }
    }
}

<content>
1: import kotlin.Boolean;
2: import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject;
3: 
4: CREATE TABLE chapters(
5:     _id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
6:     manga_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
7:     url TEXT NOT NULL,
8:     name TEXT NOT NULL,
9:     scanlator TEXT,
10:     read INTEGER AS Boolean NOT NULL,
11:     bookmark INTEGER AS Boolean NOT NULL,
12:     last_page_read INTEGER NOT NULL,
13:     chapter_number REAL NOT NULL,
14:     source_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
15:     date_fetch INTEGER NOT NULL,
16:     date_upload INTEGER NOT NULL,
17:     last_modified_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
18:     version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
19:     is_syncing INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
20:     memo BLOB AS JsonObject NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
21:     FOREIGN KEY(manga_id) REFERENCES mangas (_id)
22:     ON DELETE CASCADE
23: );
24: 
25: CREATE INDEX chapters_manga_id_index ON chapters(manga_id);
26: CREATE INDEX chapters_unread_by_manga_index ON chapters(manga_id, read) WHERE read = 0;
27: CREATE INDEX idx_chapters_url ON chapters(url);
28: 
29: CREATE TRIGGER update_last_modified_at_chapters
30: AFTER UPDATE ON chapters
31: FOR EACH ROW
32: BEGIN
33:   UPDATE chapters
34:   SET last_modified_at = strftime('%s', 'now')
35:   WHERE _id = new._id;
36: END;
37: 
38: CREATE TRIGGER update_chapter_and_manga_version AFTER UPDATE ON chapters
39: WHEN new.is_syncing = 0 AND (
40:     new.read != old.read OR
41:     new.bookmark != old.bookmark OR
42:     new.last_page_read != old.last_page_read
43: )
44: BEGIN
45:     -- Update the chapter version
46:     UPDATE chapters SET version = version + 1
47:     WHERE _id = new._id;
48: 
49:     -- Update the manga version
50:     UPDATE mangas SET version = version + 1
51:     WHERE _id = new.manga_id AND (SELECT is_syncing FROM mangas WHERE _id = new.manga_id) = 0;
52: END;
53: 
54: getChapterById:
55: SELECT *
56: FROM chapters
57: WHERE _id = :id;
58: 
59: getChaptersByMangaId:
60: SELECT C.*
61: FROM chapters C
62: LEFT JOIN excluded_scanlators ES
63: ON C.manga_id = ES.manga_id
64: AND C.scanlator = ES.scanlator
65: WHERE C.manga_id = :mangaId
66: AND (
67:     :applyScanlatorFilter = 0
68:     OR ES.scanlator IS NULL
69: );
70: 
71: getScanlatorsByMangaId:
72: SELECT scanlator
73: FROM chapters

import kotlin.Boolean;

CREATE TABLE chapters(
    _id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    manga_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

    chapter_number REAL NOT NULL,
    source_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_fetch INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_upload INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_modified_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_syncing INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    memo BLOB AS JsonObject NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    FOREIGN KEY(manga_id) REFERENCES mangas (_id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX chapters_manga_id_index ON chapters(manga_id);
CREATE INDEX chapters_unread_by_manga_index ON chapters(manga_id, read) WHERE read = 0;
CREATE INDEX idx_chapters_url ON chapters(url);

CREATE TRIGGER update_last_modified_at_chapters
AFTER UPDATE ON chapters
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  UPDATE chapters
  SET last_modified_at = strftime('%s', 'now')
  WHERE _id = new._id;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER update_chapter_and_manga_version AFTER UPDATE ON chapters
WHEN new.is_syncing = 0 AND (
    new.read != old.read OR
    new.bookmark != old.bookmark OR
    new.last_page_read != old.last_page_read
)
BEGIN
    -- Update the chapter version
    UPDATE chapters SET version = version + 1
    WHERE _id = new._id;

    -- Update the manga version
    UPDATE mangas SET version = version + 1
    WHERE _id = new.manga_id AND (SELECT is_syncing FROM mangas WHERE _id = new.manga_id) = 0;
END;

        :lastUpdate, :nextUpdate, :initialized, :viewerFlags, :chapterFlags, :coverLastModified, :dateAdded,
        :updateStrategy, :calculateInterval, 0, :version, :memo
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 0 FROM mangas WHERE source = :source AND url = :url);

    -- Update the relevant details if applicable and not favorite
    UPDATE mangas
    SET
        title = CASE WHEN :updateTitle THEN :title ELSE title END,
        thumbnail_url = CASE WHEN :updateCover THEN :thumbnailUrl ELSE thumbnail_url END,
        author = CASE WHEN :updateDetails THEN :author ELSE author END,
        artist = CASE WHEN :updateDetails THEN :artist ELSE artist END,
        description = CASE WHEN :updateDetails THEN :description ELSE description END,
        genre = CASE WHEN :updateDetails THEN :genre ELSE genre END,
        status = CASE WHEN :updateDetails THEN :status ELSE status END,
        update_strategy = CASE WHEN :updateDetails THEN :updateStrategy ELSE update_strategy END,
        initialized = :updateDetails,
        memo = :memo
    WHERE source = :source
    AND url = :url
    AND favorite = 0;

    -- Finally return the manga
    SELECT *
    FROM mangas
    WHERE source = :source
    AND url = :url
    LIMIT 1;
}

        val snackbarHostState = remember { SnackbarHostState() }

                val msgRes = when {

                    category != null -> MR.strings.updating_category

                snackbarHostState.showSnackbar(context.stringResource(msgRes))

            started

                    defaultCategoryTitle = stringResource(MR.strings.label_default),
                    page = state.coercedActiveCategoryIndex,

                    title = title,
                    onClickUnselectAll = screenModel::clearSelection,
                    onClickSelectAll = screenModel::selectAll,

36:         if (chapterIsReady(chapter)) {

38:         }
39:

41:         withIOContext {
42:             logcat { "Loading pages for ${chapter.chapter.name}" }
43:             try {

45:                 chapter.pageLoader = loader
46:

49: 
50:                 if (pages.isEmpty()) {
51:                     throw Exception(context.stringResource(MR.strings.page_list_empty_error))
52:                 }
53: 
54:                 // If the chapter is partially read, set the starting page to the last the user read
55:                 // otherwise use the requested page.
56:                 if (!chapter.chapter.read) {
57:                     chapter.requestedPage = chapter.chapter.last_page_read
58:                 }
59: 
60:                 chapter.state = ReaderChapter.State.Loaded(pages)
61:             } catch (e: Throwable) {
62:                 chapter.state = ReaderChapter.State.Error(e)
63:                 throw e

65:         }

53: actual class LocalSource(

57: ) : Source, UnmeteredSource {
58: 
59:     private val json: Json by injectLazy()
60:     private val xml: XML by injectLazy()
61: 
62:     /** Кэш «имя манги -> жанры из ComicInfo.xml» + общий отсортированный список. */
63:     private val genreCache = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, List<String>>()
64: 
65:     private fun genresOf(mangaDir: UniFile): List<String> {
66:         val key = mangaDir.name.orEmpty()
67:         genreCache[key]?.let { return it }
68:         val genres = runCatching {
69:             if (!mangaDir.isDirectory) return@runCatching emptyList()
70:             val comicInfo = mangaDir.listFiles().orEmpty()
71:                 .firstOrNull { it.name == COMIC_INFO_FILE } ?: return@runCatching emptyList()
72:             val text = comicInfo.openInputStream().bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
73:             Regex("<Genre>(.*?)</Genre>", RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL)
74:                 .find(text)
75:                 ?.groupValues?.get(1)
76:                 ?.split(',', ';')
77:                 ?.map { it.trim() }
78:                 ?.filter { it.isNotBlank() }
79:                 .orEmpty()
80:         }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
81:         genreCache[key] = genres
82:         return genres
83:     }
84: 
85:     private fun allKnownGenres(): List<String> {
86:         // Прогреваем кэш по всем мангам (быстро: только ComicInfo.xml корня)
87:         fileSystem.getFilesInBaseDirectory()
88:             .filter { it.isDirectory }
89:             .forEach { genresOf(it) }
90:         return genreCache.values.flatten().distinct().sortedWith(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER)
91:     }

93:     @Suppress("PrivatePropertyName")
94:     private val PopularFilters = FilterList(OrderBy.Popular(context))
95: 
96:     @Suppress("PrivatePropertyName")
97:     private val LatestFilters = FilterList(OrderBy.Latest(context))
98: 
99:     override val name: String = context.stringResource(MR.strings.local_source)
100: 
101:     override val id: Long = ID
102:

106:

108:

110:     override suspend fun getPopularManga(page: Int) = getSearchManga(page, "", PopularFilters)
111: 
112:     override suspend fun getLatestUpdates(page: Int) = getSearchManga(page, "", LatestFilters)
113: 
114:     override suspend fun getSearchManga(page: Int, query: String, filters: FilterList): MangasPage = withIOContext {
115:         val lastModifiedLimit = if (filters === LatestFilters) {
116:             System.currentTimeMillis() - LATEST_THRESHOLD
117:         } else {
118:             0L
119:         }
120: 
121:         var mangaDirs = fileSystem.getFilesInBaseDirectory()
122:             // Папки-манги И одиночные архивы CBZ/CBR/ZIP (как в CDisplayEx)
123:             .filter { (it.isDirectory || Archive.isSupported(it)) && !it.name.orEmpty().startsWith('.') }
124:             .distinctBy { it.name }
125:             .filter {
126:                 if (lastModifiedLimit == 0L && query.isBlank()) {
127:                     true
128:                 } else if (lastModifiedLimit == 0L) {
129:                     // Обычный запрос — поиск по подстроке, запрос с маркером «#»
130:                     // — алфавитный указатель (см. LibraryIndex). Разбор живёт в
131:                     // domain и покрыт юнит-тестами.
132:                     LibraryIndex.matches(it.name.orEmpty(), query)
133:                 } else {
134:                     it.lastModified() >= lastModifiedLimit
135:                 }
136:             }
137: 
138:         filters.forEach { filter ->
139:             when (filter) {
140:                 is GenreFilter -> {
141:                     val genre = filter.selectedGenre
142:                     if (genre != null) {
143:                         mangaDirs = mangaDirs.filter { dir ->
144:                             genresOf(dir).any { it.equals(genre, ignoreCase = true) }
145:                         }
146:                     }
147:                 }
148:                 is OrderBy.Popular -> {
149:                     mangaDirs = if (filter.state!!.ascending) {
150:                         mangaDirs.sortedWith(compareBy(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER) { it.name.orEmpty() })
151:                     } else {
152:                         mangaDirs.sortedWith(compareByDescending(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER) { it.name.orEmpty() })
153:                     }
154:                 }
155:                 is OrderBy.Latest -> {
156:                     mangaDirs = if (filter.state!!.ascending) {
157:                         mangaDirs.sortedBy(UniFile::lastModified)
158:                     } else {
159:                         mangaDirs.sortedByDescending(UniFile::lastModified)
160:                     }
161:                 }
162:                 else -> {
163:                     /* Do nothing */
164:                 }
165:             }
166:         }
167: 
168:         val mangas = mangaDirs
169:             .map { mangaDir ->
170:                 async {
171:                     SManga.create().apply {
172:                         title = if (mangaDir.isDirectory) {
173:                             mangaDir.name.orEmpty()
174:                         } else {
175:                             mangaDir.nameWithoutExtension.orEmpty()
176:                         }
177:                         url = mangaDir.name.orEmpty()
178: 
179:                         // Обложка: ТОЛЬКО из кэша — листинг каталога мгновенный.
180:                         // Отсутствующие обложки генерируются в фоне по одной
181:                         // (см. scheduleCoverGeneration) и появляются при
182:                         // следующей перерисовке, не блокируя UI.
183:                         val cover = coverManager.find(mangaDir.name.orEmpty())
184:                         if (cover != null) {
185:                             thumbnail_url = cover.uri.toString()
186:                         } else {
187:                             scheduleCoverGeneration(mangaDir, this)
188:                         }
189:                     }
190:                 }
191:             }
192:             .awaitAll()
193: 
194:         MangasPage(mangas, false)
195:     }

197:     override suspend fun getMangaUpdate(
198:         manga: SManga,
199:         chapters: List<SChapter>,
200:         fetchDetails: Boolean,
201:         fetchChapters: Boolean,
202:     ): SMangaUpdate = supervisorScope {
203:         val asyncManga = if (fetchDetails) async { getMangaDetails(manga) } else null
204:         val asyncChapters = if (fetchChapters) async { getChapterList(manga) } else null
205:         SMangaUpdate(asyncManga?.await() ?: manga, asyncChapters?.await() ?: chapters)
206:     }
207: 
208:     // Manga details related
209:     private suspend fun getMangaDetails(manga: SManga): SManga = withIOContext {
210:         coverManager.find(manga.url)?.let {
211:             manga.thumbnail_url = it.uri.toString()
212:         }
213: 
214:         // Augment manga details based on metadata files
215:         try {
216:             val mangaDir = fileSystem.getMangaDirectory(manga.url) ?: error("${manga.url} is not a valid directory")
217:             val mangaDirFiles = mangaDir.listFiles().orEmpty()
218: 
219:             val comicInfoFile = mangaDirFiles
220:                 .firstOrNull { it.name == COMIC_INFO_FILE }
221:             val noXmlFile = mangaDirFiles
222:                 .firstOrNull { it.name == ".noxml" }
223:             val legacyJsonDetailsFile = mangaDirFiles
224:                 .firstOrNull { it.extension == "json" }
225: 
226:             when {
227:                 // Top level ComicInfo.xml
228:                 comicInfoFile != null -> {
229:                     noXmlFile?.delete()
230:                     setMangaDetailsFromComicInfoFile(comicInfoFile.openInputStream(), manga)
231:                 }
232: 
233:                 // Old custom JSON format
234:                 // TODO: remove support for this entirely after a while
235:                 legacyJsonDetailsFile != null -> {
236:                     json.decodeFromStream<MangaDetails>(legacyJsonDetailsFile.openInputStream()).run {
237:                         title?.let { manga.title = it }
238:                         author?.let { manga.author = it }
239:                         artist?.let { manga.artist = it }
240:                         description?.let { manga.description = it }
241:                         genre?.let { manga.genre = it.joinToString() }
242:                         status?.let { manga.status = it }
243:                     }
244:                     // Replace with ComicInfo.xml file
245:                     val comicInfo = manga.getComicInfo()
246:                     mangaDir
247:                         .createFile(COMIC_INFO_FILE)
248:                         ?.openOutputStream()
249:                         ?.use {
250:                             val comicInfoString = xml.encodeToString(ComicInfo.serializer(), comicInfo)
251:                             it.write(comicInfoString.toByteArray())
252:                             legacyJsonDetailsFile.delete()
253:                         }
254:                 }
255: 
256:                 // Copy ComicInfo.xml from chapter archive to top level if found
257:                 noXmlFile == null -> {
258:                     val chapterArchives = mangaDirFiles.filter(Archive::isSupported)
259: 
260:                     val copiedFile = copyComicInfoFileFromChapters(chapterArchives, mangaDir)
261:                     if (copiedFile != null) {
262:                         setMangaDetailsFromComicInfoFile(copiedFile.openInputStream(), manga)
263:                     } else {
264:                         // Avoid re-scanning
265:                         mangaDir.createFile(".noxml")
266:                     }
267:                 }
268:             }
269:         } catch (e: Throwable) {
270:             logcat(LogPriority.ERROR, e) { "Error setting manga details from local metadata for ${manga.title}" }
271:         }
272: 
273:         return@withIOContext manga
274:     }
275: 
276:     private fun <T> getComicInfoForChapter(chapter: UniFile, block: (InputStream) -> T): T? {
277:         return if (chapter.isDirectory) {
278:             chapter.findFile(COMIC_INFO_FILE)?.openInputStream()?.use(block)
279:         } else {
280:             chapter.archiveReader(context).use { reader ->
281:                 reader.getInputStream(COMIC_INFO_FILE)?.use(block)
282:             }
283:         }
284:     }
285: 
286:     private fun copyComicInfoFileFromChapters(chapterArchives: List<UniFile>, folder: UniFile): UniFile? {
287:         for (chapter in chapterArchives) {
288:             val file = getComicInfoForChapter(chapter) f@{ stream ->
289:                 return@f copyComicInfoFile(stream, folder)
290:             }
291:             if (file != null) return file
292:         }
293:         return null
294:     }
295: 
296:     private fun copyComicInfoFile(comicInfoFileStream: InputStream, folder: UniFile): UniFile? {
297:         return folder.createFile(COMIC_INFO_FILE)?.apply {
298:             openOutputStream().use { outputStream ->
299:                 comicInfoFileStream.use { it.copyTo(outputStream) }
300:             }
301:         }
302:     }
303: 
304:     private fun parseComicInfo(stream: InputStream): ComicInfo {
305:         return AndroidXmlReader(stream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8.name()).use {
306:             xml.decodeFromReader<ComicInfo>(it)
307:         }
308:     }
309: 
310:     private fun setMangaDetailsFromComicInfoFile(stream: InputStream, manga: SManga) {
311:         manga.copyFromComicInfo(parseComicInfo(stream))
312:     }
313: 
314:     private fun setChapterDetailsFromComicInfoFile(stream: InputStream, chapter: SChapter) {
315:         val comicInfo = parseComicInfo(stream)
316: 
317:         comicInfo.title?.let { chapter.name = it.value }
318:         comicInfo.number?.value?.toFloatOrNull()?.let { chapter.chapter_number = it }
319:         comicInfo.translator?.let { chapter.scanlator = it.value }
320:     }
321: 
322:     // Chapters
323:     private suspend fun getChapterList(manga: SManga): List<SChapter> = withIOContext {
324:         // Одиночный архив (CBZ/CBR в корне хранилища): манга = единственная глава
325:         val singleArchive = fileSystem.getMangaDirectory(manga.url) == null
326:         if (singleArchive) {
327:             val file = fileSystem.findEntry(manga.url)
328:             if (file != null && Archive.isSupported(file)) {
329:                 val chapter = SChapter.create().apply {
330:                     url = manga.url
331:                     name = file.nameWithoutExtension.orEmpty()
332:                     date_upload = file.lastModified()
333:                     chapter_number = 1f
334:                 }
335:                 if (manga.thumbnail_url.isNullOrBlank()) {
336:                     updateCover(chapter, manga)
337:                 }
338:                 return@withIOContext listOf(chapter)
339:             }
340:             return@withIOContext emptyList()
341:         }
342: 
343:         val chapters = fileSystem.getFilesInMangaDirectory(manga.url)
344:             // Only keep supported formats
345:             .filterNot { it.name.orEmpty().startsWith('.') }
346:             .filterNot { it.name.orEmpty().lowercase() in setOf("local", "downloads", "backup", "autobackup", "covers") }
347:             // Папка-глава засчитывается только если в ней есть изображения —
348:             // случайные служебные подпапки больше не выглядят «главами»
349:             .filter { entry ->
350:                 when {
351:                     Archive.isSupported(entry) || entry.extension.equals("epub", true) -> true
352:                     entry.isDirectory -> entry.listFiles().orEmpty().any { page ->
353:                         ImageUtil.isImage(page.name) { page.openInputStream() }
354:                     }
355:                     else -> false
356:                 }
357:             }
358:             .map { chapterFile ->
359:                 SChapter.create().apply {
360:                     url = "${manga.url}/${chapterFile.name}"
361:                     name = if (chapterFile.isDirectory) {
362:                         chapterFile.name
363:                     } else {
364:                         chapterFile.nameWithoutExtension
365:                     }.orEmpty()
366:                     date_upload = chapterFile.lastModified()
367:                     chapter_number = ChapterRecognition
368:                         .parseChapterNumber(manga.title, this.name, this.chapter_number.toDouble())
369:                         .toFloat()
370: 
371:                     val format = Format.valueOf(chapterFile)
372:                     if (format is Format.Epub) {
373:                         format.file.epubReader(context).use { epub ->
374:                             epub.fillMetadata(manga, this)
375:                         }
376:                     } else {
377:                         getComicInfoForChapter(chapterFile) { stream ->
378:                             setChapterDetailsFromComicInfoFile(stream, this)
379:                         }
380:                     }
381:                 }
382:             }
383:             .sortedWith { c1, c2 ->
384:                 c2.name.compareToCaseInsensitiveNaturalOrder(c1.name)
385:             }
386: 
387:         // Copy the cover from the first chapter found if not available
388:         if (manga.thumbnail_url.isNullOrBlank()) {
389:             chapters.lastOrNull()?.let { chapter ->
390:                 updateCover(chapter, manga)
391:             }
392:         }
393: 
394:         chapters
395:     }

398:     override fun getFilterList() = FilterList(
399:         OrderBy.Popular(context),
400:         GenreFilter(runCatching { allKnownGenres() }.getOrDefault(emptyList())),
401:     )

406:     fun getFormat(chapter: SChapter): Format {
407:         try {
408:             val parts = chapter.url.split('/', limit = 2)
409:             val entry = if (parts.size == 2) {
410:                 fileSystem.findEntry(parts[0])?.findFile(parts[1])
411:             } else {
412:                 // Одиночный архив: манга = глава, url без '/'
413:                 fileSystem.findEntry(parts[0])
414:             }
415:             return entry
416:                 ?.let(Format.Companion::valueOf)
417:                 ?: throw Exception(context.stringResource(MR.strings.chapter_not_found))
418:         } catch (e: Format.UnknownFormatException) {
419:             throw Exception(context.stringResource(MR.strings.local_invalid_format))
420:         } catch (e: Exception) {
421:             throw e
422:         }
423:     }
424: 
425:     /**
426:      * Генерирует обложку сразу при сканировании каталога: одиночный архив —
427:      * первая картинка внутри; папка-манга — первая картинка первой главы.
428:      * Дорогая часть выполняется один раз, дальше отдаётся из кэша .covers/cover.jpg.
429:      */
430:     private val coverQueue = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue<Pair<UniFile, SManga>>()
431:     private val coverQueued = java.util.Collections.newSetFromMap(
432:         java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, Boolean>(),
433:     )
434:     private val coverWorkerRunning = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(false)
435:     private val coverScope = kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope(
436:         kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob() + kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.IO,
437:     )
438: 
439:     /** Ставит генерацию обложки в фоновую очередь (один воркер, по одной). */
440:     private fun scheduleCoverGeneration(entry: UniFile, manga: SManga) {
441:         val key = entry.name.orEmpty()
442:         if (key.isBlank() || !coverQueued.add(key)) return
443:         coverQueue.add(entry to manga.apply { url = entry.name.orEmpty() })
444:         if (coverWorkerRunning.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
445:             coverScope.launch {
446:                 try {
447:                     while (true) {
448:                         val (dir, m) = coverQueue.poll() ?: break
449:                         runCatching { tryGenerateCover(dir, m) }
450:                     }
451:                 } finally {
452:                     coverWorkerRunning.set(false)
453:                 }
454:             }
455:         }
456:     }
457: 
458:     private fun tryGenerateCover(entry: UniFile, manga: SManga): UniFile? {
459:         return runCatching {
460:             val chapterFile = if (entry.isDirectory) {
461:                 entry.listFiles().orEmpty()
462:                     .filterNot { it.name.orEmpty().startsWith('.') }
463:                     .filter { it.isDirectory || Archive.isSupported(it) }
464:                     .minByOrNull { it.name.orEmpty().lowercase() }
465:             } else {
466:                 entry.takeIf { Archive.isSupported(it) }
467:             } ?: return null
468: 
469:             val chapter = SChapter.create().apply {
470:                 url = if (entry.isDirectory) "${entry.name}/${chapterFile.name}" else entry.name.orEmpty()
471:                 name = chapterFile.nameWithoutExtension.orEmpty()
472:             }
473:             updateCover(chapter, manga)
474:         }.getOrNull()
475:     }
476: 
477:     private fun updateCover(chapter: SChapter, manga: SManga): UniFile? {
478:         return try {
479:             when (val format = getFormat(chapter)) {
480:                 is Format.Directory -> {
481:                     val entry = format.file.listFiles()
482:                         ?.sortedWith { f1, f2 ->
483:                             f1.name.orEmpty().compareToCaseInsensitiveNaturalOrder(
484:                                 f2.name.orEmpty(),
485:                             )
486:                         }
487:                         ?.find {
488:                             !it.isDirectory && ImageUtil.isImage(it.name) { it.openInputStream() }
489:                         }
490: 
491:                     entry?.let { coverManager.update(manga, it.openInputStream()) }
492:                 }
493:                 is Format.Archive -> {
494:                     format.file.archiveReader(context).use { reader ->
495:                         val entry = reader.useEntries { entries ->
496:                             entries
497:                                 .sortedWith { f1, f2 -> f1.name.compareToCaseInsensitiveNaturalOrder(f2.name) }
498:                                 .find { it.isFile && ImageUtil.isImage(it.name) { reader.getInputStream(it.name)!! } }
499:                         }
500: 
501:                         entry?.let { coverManager.update(manga, reader.getInputStream(it.name)!!) }
502:                     }
503:                 }
504:                 is Format.Epub -> {
505:                     format.file.epubReader(context).use { epub ->
506:                         val entry = epub.getImagesFromPages().firstOrNull()
507: 
508:                         entry?.let { coverManager.update(manga, epub.getInputStream(it)!!) }
509:                     }
510:                 }
511:             }
512:         } catch (e: Throwable) {
513:             logcat(LogPriority.ERROR, e) { "Error updating cover for ${manga.title}" }
514:             null
515:         }
516:     }
517: 
518:     companion object {
519:         const val ID = 0L
520:         const val HELP_URL = "https://yomihon.github.io/docs/guides/local-source/"
521: 
522:         private val LATEST_THRESHOLD = 7.days.inWholeMilliseconds
523:     }
524: }

=== llm-runner ===
name: LLM Runner

# A GGUF model runs on a GitHub-hosted runner. llama.cpp exposes an
# OpenAI-compatible API through a Cloudflare quick tunnel; the Android app
# discovers the endpoint from a run-scoped artifact.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      model:
        description: "GGUF model key"
        required: true
        default: "qwen2.5-1.5b"
        type: choice
        options:
          - qwen2.5-0.5b
          - qwen2.5-1.5b
          - llama3.2-1b
          - gemma3-1b
          - custom
      session:
        description: "Session id (random, from the app)"
        required: true
        type: string
      custom_url:
        description: "Custom GGUF direct URL (used when model=custom)"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      os:
        description: "Runner OS"
        required: false
        default: "linux"
        type: choice
        options:
          - linux
          - windows

run-name: "LLM ${{ inputs.model }} @${{ inputs.os }} (${{ inputs.session }})"

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  # Pin a known-good release. `/releases/latest` can point to a metadata-only
  # release (v0.2.0 currently does), which made both jobs fail immediately.
  LLAMA_CPP_TAG: b10549

jobs:
  serve-linux:
    if: inputs.os == 'linux'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 330
    steps:
      - name: Download llama.cpp server (Linux)
        env:
          ASSET: llama-b10549-bin-ubuntu-x64.tar.gz
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          URL="https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/${LLAMA_CPP_TAG}/${ASSET}"

  ```
## 5. Продвинутый уровень — архитектура, надёжность, качество

### 5.1 Принципы, применённые при исправлении

| Принцип | Как применён |
|---------|--------------|
| **Fail-safe** | `TODO` → `emptyList()` + `log WARN` вместо краша. `runCatching` вокруг каждого инстанса, `addSuppressed` для диагностики. |
| **Idempotency** | `distinctBy { tracking_url }`, `trim()` запроса, пустой запрос без сети. |
| **Observability** | `logcat(DEBUG/WARN/ERROR)` в каждой ветке, `tookMs` в Suwayomi, `OcrStageBus` для OCR. |
| **Compatibility** | Komga POST→GET fallback, Suwayomi `includesInsensitive` (работает и на старых, и на новых), Kavita `/Search/search` (0.8.x). |
| **No magic values** | `SEARCH_LIMIT` вынесен в `companion`, `HARD_UTTERANCE_LIMIT` прокомментирован, `OcrTuning` через провайдер. |
| **Единый источник истины** | `OcrRegionRules`, `OcrPlugins`, `VoicePlugins`, `AiBackends` — реестры, а не разбросанные `when`. |
| **Безопасность** | `Uri.encode`, экранирование GraphQL, `Dns.SYSTEM` (не DoH для IP), `withIOContext` / `withTimeoutOrNull(120_000)` в `AiAgent`. |

### 5.2 OCR — почему `UnavailableDetOcrEngine` не заглушка

`CyrillicOcrEngine` требует три файла (`cyrillic_detector.tflite`, `cyrillic_recognizer.tflite`, словарь). Если их нет — `OcrRepositoryImpl.cyrillicModelsInstalled()` = `false`, создаётся `UnavailableDetOcrEngine`. `scanLocally` ловит `DetectionUnavailable` и делает `recognizeText(wholePage)` — один регион во весь лист. Это **деградация**, а не фейк: пользователь видит текст, пусть и без разбиения по пузырям. Когда пак скачан — путь `detectRegions → crop → recognizeLine` даёт по региону на реплику.

Дополнительно продвинуто:
- `OcrTuning` пресеты (`balanced` = старые константы байт-в-байт, `manga`/`manhwa`/`comic`) + `OcrTuningOverrides` с клампингом.
- `CtcScoring` (coverage, softmax blank) — отсекает выпавшие буквы `ОН БЫЛ` → `н был`.
- `OcrTextCleaner.joinLineHyphens` — склейка `ХО-\nРОШО` → `ХОРОШО`, но не `мама-нама`.
- `OcrCacheStore` + `OcrStageBus` → индикатор «Сканирование 2/10».

### 5.3 StubSource — не фейк, а миграция

Удалённый источник → `StubSource(id, lang, name)` остаётся в БД. `AndroidSourceManager` держит `stubSourcesMap` и `sourcesMapFlow` (ConcurrentHashMap, `StateFlow`). При переустановке расширения `registerStubSource` вызывает `DownloadManager.renameSource`. Пользователь видит «Источник не установлен» и может мигрировать главы — без потери библиотеки.
  ```

# Yomikai — отчёт по ключевым паттернам

Проект: `/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code` (форк Mihon, KMP-source-set`ы`, ~модульная архитектура).

---

## 1. UI-технологии и версии

**Compose — основной UI, Material3.** Исключения (наследие Mihon): читалка манг (`ui/reader/`) сделана на View + ViewPager/RecyclerView + ViewBinding; Glance — для виджетов.

Каталоги версий — **два** (версии вынесены из корневого build):

|---|---|
| `/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/gradle/libs.versions.toml` | основной каталог (243 строки), alias `libs.*` |
| `/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/gradle/mihon.versions.toml` | catalog `mihonx` — SDK/Java/NDK: `android-sdk-min = "26"`, `android-sdk-compile = "37"`, `android-sdk-target = "36"`, `java = "17"`, `android-ndk = "29.0.14206865"` |

Ключевые версии (`gradle/libs.versions.toml`):

Material3 подключён явно (`libs.androidx.compose.material3`), плюс опт-ины `androidx.compose.material3.ExperimentalMaterial3Api` и `ExperimentalMaterial3ExpressiveApi` в `app/build.gradle.kts:232-233`.

Convention-плагины в included build `gradle/build-logic` (`src/main/kotlin/PluginComposeAndroid.kt` — ставит `buildFeatures.compose = true`, подключает BOM и `ui-tooling-preview` как `api`).

Модули (`settings.gradle.kts`): `app`, `baseline-profile`, `core-metadata`, `core:archive`, `core:common`, `data`, `domain`, `i18n`, `presentation-core`, `presentation-widget`, `source-api`, `source-local`, `telemetry`. Плюс отдельно лежит несобранный `overlay-reader/` (другой gradle-проект).

---

## 2. `source-local` — доступ к файлам через SAF

Ключевой факт: SAF полностью скрыт за библиотекой **`com.hippo.unifile.UniFile`** (`libs.unifile`). Нигде нет прямых `DocumentsContract`/`DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUri` — работа идёт через `UniFile.listFiles()`, `findFile()`, `openInputStream()`, `createDirectory()`, `createFile()`.

### `LocalSourceFileSystem` — точка доступа к дереву
`/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/source-local/src/commonMain/kotlin/tachiyomi/source/local/io/LocalSourceFileSystem.kt`
```kotlin
expect class LocalSourceFileSystem {
    fun getBaseDirectory(): UniFile?
    fun getFilesInBaseDirectory(): List<UniFile>
    fun getMangaDirectory(name: String): UniFile?
    fun getFilesInMangaDirectory(name: String): List<UniFile>
}
```

`/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/source-local/src/androidMain/kotlin/tachiyomi/source/local/io/LocalSourceFileSystem.kt`
```kotlin
actual class LocalSourceFileSystem(private val storageManager: StorageManager) {
    @Volatile private var cachedFiles: List<UniFile>? = null
    @Volatile private var cachedRootsKey: String = ""
    private fun rootsKey(): String                      // baseDir.uri + отсортированные внешние корни
    actual fun getBaseDirectory(): UniFile?              // storageManager.getLocalSourceDirectory()
    actual fun getFilesInBaseDirectory(): List<UniFile>   // local/ + все внешние корни, кэш по rootsKey
    actual fun getMangaDirectory(name: String): UniFile?
```

## 3. `core/archive` — чтение ZIP/архивов


**`ArchiveReader.kt`** — **mmap-архив через `ParcelFileDescriptor`** (главная идея: не копировать файл, отобразить в память и листать `libarchive` без seek):

Сигнатура `getInputStream` — **линейный скан** записей до совпадения имени, возвращает сам `ArchiveInputStream`, позиционированный на нужной записи (не `null`, если не нашли):
```kotlin
fun getInputStream(entryName: String): InputStream? {
    val archive = ArchiveInputStream(address, size)
    while (true) {
        val entry = archive.getNextEntry() ?: break
        if (entry.name == entryName) return archive
    }
    archive.close(); return null
}
```

**`ArchiveInputStream.kt`** — `InputStream` поверх нативного `libarchive`:
```kotlin
internal class ArchiveInputStream(buffer: Long, size: Long) : InputStream() {
    fun getNextEntry(): MihonArchiveEntry?     // читает pathnameUtf8, filetype == AE_IFREG → isFile
    override fun read(): Int
    override fun read(b: ByteArray, off: Int, len: Int): Int
    override fun close()                        // Archive.readFree, idempotent (synchronized + @Volatile isClosed)
}
// init: Archive.setCharset(UTF_8); readSupportFilterAll; readSupportFormatAll; readOpenMemoryUnsafe(archive, buffer, size)
```

**`UniFileExtensions.kt`** — мост UniFile → PFD → reader ( SAF-путь целиком здесь):
```kotlin
internal fun UniFile.openFileDescriptor(context: Context, mode: String): ParcelFileDescriptor =
    context.contentResolver.openFileDescriptor(uri, mode) ?: error("Failed to open file descriptor: ${filePath ?: uri}")

fun UniFile.archiveReader(context: Context) = openFileDescriptor(context, "r").use { ArchiveReader(it) }
fun UniFile.epubReader(context: Context)    = EpubReader(archiveReader(context))
```

**`EpubReader.kt`** — `Closeable by reader` + разбор OPF/spine через Jsoup:
```kotlin

    fun getInputStream(entryName: String): InputStream?
    fun getImagesFromPages(): List<String>
    fun getPackageHref(): String                                  // META-INF/container.xml → rootfile@full-path
    fun getPackageDocument(ref: String): Document                 // Jsoup + Parser.xmlParser()
    private fun getPathSeparator(): String                        // "\\" или "/"
```

**`ZipWriter.kt`** — обратная запись (`Archive.writeNew` / `writeSetFormatZip` / `writeOpenFd`):

**Кэша в модуле нет.** `ArchiveReader` одноразовый: `mmap` → последовательное чтение → `munmap`. Кэширование обложек сделано выше по стеку (`.covers/`), кэш страниц — в `CoverCache`/`DiskLruCache`. Зависимости модуля (`core/archive/build.gradle.kts`): `libs.jsoup`, `libs.archive`, `libs.unifile`.
